note: San Luis Obispo County recreation area on an oak-dotted peninsula in Lopez Lake, 10 mi up Lopez Dr from Arroyo Grande; primitive, electric and full-hookup loops, several overlooking the lake. Marina with launch, store and rentals open all year; summer water park and zip-line course. Boats need inspection, and ballasted boats a 30-day quarantine. Bears are active in the campground. --Claude
summary: Lopez Lake: county WebTrac booking (now 'operator' with URL), 180-day window, 48-hour online cutoff, Fri+Sat together April-September; fees widened to $38 (primitive weekday off-season) - $65 (full hookup holiday) with $15 extra vehicle; open year-round. Lakeview kept: shore roads run between every loop and the water. Phone added.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview KEPT, checked on Esri imagery and the county campsite map. Grizzly Drive and Marina Road ring the shore between the loops and the water; the slope below the road is open grass with no pads, and the Hawk loop sits behind the marina and its parking. No site named as fronting the lake; not a candidate for an upgrade. Lake looked near full in the imagery.
